item.title: WireGuard: fast, modern, secure VPN tunnel

item.title: Quick Start - WireGuard
item.description: By default, WireGuard tries to be as silent as possible when not being used; it is not a chatty protocol. For the most part, it only transmits data when a peer wishes to send packets.
